title: Corpus layout descriptor
description: How to walk this corpus. Each kind's include globs are relative to every root. A walker's CLI, run from the repository root, prints repo-relative POSIX paths one per line in C-locale byte order: with no arguments the files of the kinds listed in documents, with kind names as arguments the files of those kinds, and with --all every kind as kind<TAB>path.

roots.description: Top-level directories the include globs are evaluated under.

include.description: Globs relative to each root. * matches within one path segment; ** matches across segments.

documents.description: The kinds that make up the corpus documents, i.e. what a consumer loads.

cli.description: Command run from the repository root.
